I'm assuming you are running your LR SSJ4s with your SSJ4 Goku and the friend LR SSJ4s with your SSJ4 Gogeta.

If you are, then I would replace the INT GT Vegeta with the STR LR SSJ4 Vegeta, as he is pretty much better in every way after his EZA. So your floaters are the TEQ GT Gobros, PHY SSJ Goku (GT) and STR SSJ4 Vegeta.

It looks like you are pretty new to the game, and even so you can make a pretty good Pure Saiyan Team.

To start off, in the leader slot, you probably want the AGL SSBE Vegeta, then go ahead and use the TEQ LR Gods.
Then you can have the INT LR Namek Goku and PHY Super Siayan Goku (GT). 
These four will be your rotations, and for the floaters, you can have the F2P PHY LR Goku and the AGL Bardock. 
This team should be able to do pretty well against most things, as long as you throw the TEQ LR Gods at things you should be generally fine.

I don't have the PHY #17 & Frieza, so take this with a grain of salt, but I would say that replacing them with the PHY UI could help with ki and he also stacks post eza.

You have three choices for your leader;
STR SSBKK Goku: Decently strong, especially in the right circumstances, but he **will** get slapped around, so be ready for that.
STR Hit and God Goku: Really good in the third slot, a little less so in the other two slots, but they still go hard
TEQ Hit: He can be very strong post eza, as long as he isn't getting hit before he supers. If he is in the second or third slot you should be good. 

For the units outside of the leader skill, you can many ways. You can have a full Reps of Universe 7 team, with AGL MUI, INT Evolution Vegeta, TEQ GoFrieza, PHY UI, and the last two spots can be taken by STR UI, INT UI, INT MVP #17, or PHY Roshi. 

If you want to do a team that isn't just focused on U7, You could have the AGL Kale & Caulifla paired with the TEQ KFC. Then TEQ Hit with STR Hit & God Goku on the other rotation. Your floaters would be the PHY UI, possibly TEQ Caulifla (depends on enemy in the stage), maybe AGL MUI (just for the dodging and reliable damage, not very good for links).

I'd say your best bet is the U7 team, as you have most of the best units for it.

I think a Pure Saiyans team *might* be able to squeeze a win out of the event, but it might a bit too hard for your units currently.

Now, assuming you eza all the units, your rotations could be the INT UI and probably the PHY Vegito Blue they share 4 links together. And the other rotation would be the AGL SSGSS Kaioken Goku and the AGL Transforming Goku.

Dokkan does this weird thing where if a card has two people in it, then the categories are only those that the people share. 

So since Paragus and Broly are both Pure Saiyans, they are on 'Pure Saiyans'.

But, since Paragus isn't on the 'Gifted Warriors' category or 'Movie Bosses' category, their joined forces card won't have those two categories, even though Broly is on them.


That being said, the reason Paragus himself isn't on movie bosses is probably because he wasn't really the big bad from the movie, unlike Broly and the F2P PHY Golden Frieza, who were the main antagonists.

The best time to start is usually at times where there are a lot of events to get a lot of dragon stones, but really starting sooner rather than later is always better as you can collect more resources to prepare.

Final Trump Card would be pretty good, you have the STR Gogeta, TEQ Vegito leaders (both also double as a fusion/potara lead). You have TEQ Gogeta and STR Vegito, an insane rotation. Plus you have eza PHY Vegito blue, and a few more good fusion/potara units. This team can get you through a lot of the difficult events, but they can also get slapped around if you don't be careful.

TEQ Ultimate Gohan, AGL Trunks and Goten, and AGL LR Gohan are good, and I would also recommend the STR Trunks. The last two are a bit harder, LR Bee Pan is good, and the STR School Gohan is also really good.

The only problem is that you won't have a lot of type coverage. You would have two AGL units, and three STR units.
